// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-MODEL-METHOD
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

// A parent–teacher message is about a named child (SAFEGUARDING rule 21), and
// MessageThread / Message / MessageThreadShare sit in CREDENTIAL_NEVER: no read
// of any shape, not even a count that could confirm a thread exists.
export async function unansweredThreads() {
  return db.messageThread.findMany({ where: { lastMessageAt: { not: null } }, take: 20 });
}
